cards.title: Limitation of Sparse AUC Standard Errors with Log-Trapezoidal Rules
cards.claim: The standard error calculations for AUC (SE_AUClast and SE_AUCall) in the sparse sampling module depend on AUC being a linear combination of the mean concentrations. Consequently, SE_AUClast and SE_AUCall are NOT included in the output when log-trapezoidal rules are specified as the method for computing AUC.
conditions: Applies when log-trapezoidal integration is selected for AUC calculation.
Applies to sparse sampling data structures.
required_inputs: Selection of log-trapezoidal rule for AUC computation in Phoenix settings.
limitations: Users cannot obtain SE_AUClast/SE_AUCall if log-trapezoidal rules are used.
Linear trapezoidal rules are required to generate these specific SE metrics.
cards.downstream_use: When reporting uncertainty for AUC in sparse pre-clinical studies, verify if linear or log-trapezoidal rules were used. If log-trapezoidal was used, alternative uncertainty metrics or linear rule justification may be needed.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
